meta.intended_use: 中学校バスケットボール部のデジタル作戦盤教材
meta.source_policy: 公開資料で動きを確認できたものを登録。推測で動きを補完しない。

official_guidance.JBA_note: U15指導内容指針案では1on1、オフボールスクリーン、5アウト、4アウト1イン等を扱い、セットプレーはU16以降に配置されている。
official_guidance.JBA_set_play_note: JBAの年代別指導内容指針では「セットプレーの導入」がU16から示されている。本アプリではこれを「U16以降の資料・戦術」として別カテゴリにする。中学校部活動で採用する場合は、顧問がチームの発達段階と実情を確認して使用する。

supplementary_sources.title: USA Basketball - Coaches Corner: Baseline Out Of Bounds Plays
USA Basketball - Coaches Corner: Sideline Out Of Bounds Play

implementation_rules: Source play and team-specific adaptation must be stored separately.
Do not reproduce source diagrams as images; redraw court, players, arrows and screens in SVG/canvas.
Every play should support left-right mirroring.
Every play should support player-focus mode O1-O5.
Unknown or diagram-only roles must not be invented.
Use source URLs inside the app's data for teacher reference.
meta.advanced_set_source: FIBA WABC Level 3 Coaching Manual Chapter 2.1にはFlex、Shuffle、Triangle、Horns、Princeton、UCLA Cut、Zipperが掲載され、Chapter 2.3にはPistolとElevator screensが掲載されている。

tactics.name: Box Gator
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Box Baseline Out-of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O4 and O5 set an elevator screen for O2.
O2 cuts through the elevator screen for a pass and shot.
After O2 cuts, O3 and O5 reposition to form a second elevator screen.
O4 cuts through the second elevator screen for a pass and lay-up.

player_roles.5: First screen and second screen participant

tactics.adaptation_note: Rebuild exact coordinates from the source diagram before final app use.

tactics.name: Box-1
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Box Baseline Out-of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O4 screens for O5; O5 cuts to the opposite block.
O4 seals the screened defender and rolls to the hoop.
O1 cuts around O3's down-screen to the top.
O3 moves to the weak-side corner after screening.

player_roles.1: Uses O3 down-screen and fills top

tactics.adaptation_note: The source uses O1-O5 labels; exact starting coordinates must follow the source diagram.

tactics.name: Box-2
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Box Baseline Out-of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O3 back-screens for O5, who seeks inside position on the opposite low block.
O4 fakes in, cuts to the corner and receives the inbound pass.
O1 cuts to the top ball-side area.
O4 passes to O1.
O4 down-screens for O2.
O2 cuts around the screen to the ball-side corner for the shot.
options: O4 post if defender closes out
tactics.adaptation_note: Zone variation is also documented but should be stored as a separate variant.

tactics.name: Box-3
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Box Baseline Out-of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O4 screens for O5; O5 cuts around the screen and may receive the inbound pass.
O4 seals for inside position and may receive the pass.
O1 screens for O2.
O2 cuts to the wing for a possible pass and shot.
O1 pops to the top after screening.

player_roles.3: Source diagram participant; exact role to be taken from diagram

tactics.adaptation_note: One source sentence does not fully describe O3; do not invent a role beyond the diagram.

tactics.name: Box-54
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Box Baseline Out-of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O5 back-screens for O4.
Inbound pass goes to O2 in the ball-side corner.
O4 cuts around O5 for a possible lay-up.
If defense switches and follows O4, O4 clears to the opposite block.
O5 seals and rolls to the ball-side block for a possible pass and lay-up.

player_roles.3: Source diagram participant; exact role to be taken from diagram

tactics.adaptation_note: The exact 5-player starting alignment should be reconstructed from the source diagrams.

tactics.name: Wheel
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Miscellaneous Baseline Out-of-Bounds Plays
steps: O1 curls around the stack toward the basket and looks for the pass.
If no pass, O1 clears to the opposite short corner.
O2 delays, curls around the stack and looks for the pass at the ball-side short corner.
O4 moves into the paint and O5 moves to the point.
If O5 receives the ball, O3 slips into the opposite low post for a return pass.
tactics.adaptation_note: The source contains a related 'Wheel and Back' counter; store it as a separate variant if needed.

tactics.name: Triangle
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Sideline Out-Of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O2 screens for O3; O3 cuts to the corner.
O5 down-screens for O2.
O2 cuts to the top for a possible shot.
If defense switches O5's screen, O5 seals the defender and looks for the inbound pass and lay-up.

player_roles.1: Source diagram participant; exact role from diagram
player_roles.2: Screens O3 then receives screen from O5

tactics.adaptation_note: Use source diagram for exact starting spots.

tactics.name: Box-1
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Sideline Out-Of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O4 and O5 set down-screens for O2 and O3.
O2 and O3 cut toward the three-point area.
O3 receives the inbound pass; O2 stays as a safety.
O5 back-screens for O1.
O1 cuts baseline-side to the hoop.
O3 looks to pass to O1.
If defended, O5 can seal and roll; otherwise flow to half-court offense.
tactics.adaptation_note: Half-court continuation is explicitly part of the source description.

tactics.name: Box-2
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Sideline Out-Of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O2 down-screens for O1.
O2 then uses the staggered screen from O5 and O4.
O2 is the intended shooter and can receive from O3 or O1.
O2 can shoot or pass to O4 posting up.
O5 can flash high and clear for a lob or hi-low option.
tactics.adaptation_note: The source also gives a 2-3 zone variation; keep it as a separate variant.

tactics.name: Circle
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Sideline Out-Of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O2 curls around the O4-O5 double-screen to the opposite wing.
O1 follows O2 and is targeted for the inbound pass from O3.
O3 moves to the ball-side corner after passing.
O5 and O4 sprint into a staggered double-screen.
O2 uses the staggered screens for a possible three-point shot or drive.
If screens are switched, O5 can slip inside for a pass.

player_roles.5: First and second screen participant / slip

tactics.adaptation_note: Exact timing between the first and second screen should be preserved in the animation.

tactics.name: Pairs
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Sideline Out-Of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O4 screens for O2.
O2 cuts over or under depending on sideline depth and defensive position.
O3 looks first to O2.
O2 can shoot or pass inside to O4.
O5 screens for O1.
O1 is the safety option if O2 is not open.
tactics.adaptation_note: The source explicitly describes cutting choice based on inbound position.

tactics.name: Stack-2
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Sideline Out-Of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O1 screens for O2 and then replaces O2's spot.
O2 fakes a V-cut, uses O1's screen and runs the near sideline.
If no pass, O2 moves to the ball-side corner.
O5 takes steps away and back-screens O4.
O4 cuts to the opposite side using the back-screen.
If no first option, an inbound lob to O4 is available; otherwise pass to O1 or O5 and run normal offense.
tactics.adaptation_note: Source warns stack spacing relative to the sideline and lane line; reproduce that spacing rule in teaching notes.

tactics.name: Kansas
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Sideline Out-Of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O1 pops out of the stack for the inbound pass and dribbles toward the top-right area.
O4 clears to the opposite corner.
O2 drops inside and curls around O5's screen for a pass from O1.
O2 can shoot or pass to O5 rolling to the hoop.
On the counter, O2 fakes the curl and back-cuts to the hoop for a pass from O1.
tactics.adaptation_note: The source presents the back-cut as a counter after the curl has been shown to the defense.

tactics.name: Celtics
tactics.source_title: Coach's Clipboard - Sideline Out-Of-Bounds Basketball Plays
steps: O4 down-screens for O1.
O1 cuts to the top and receives the inbound pass from O3.
O4 posts briefly and may receive; otherwise clears to the opposite short corner.
O1 can use a fake handoff to drive.
O1 can instead hand off to O3.
O3 runs pick-and-roll or pick-and-pop with O5 while O1 clears to the left wing.
tactics.adaptation_note: The source states that the fake handoff becomes more effective after defenders start cheating toward the handoff.

tactics.name: 5-Out Pass & Cut / Replacing the Cutter
tactics.source_title: FIBA/WABC Level 1 Coaching Manual
steps: Ball-handler passes and cuts to the basket.
The nearest player cuts toward the ball and fills the perimeter space.
Other players balance to fill perimeter positions.
The cutter first threatens the basket before filling outside.

player_roles.2: Receiver and perimeter filler as sequence progresses

tactics.adaptation_note: FIBA describes the movement principle rather than one immutable five-player play; store it as a motion rule, not a fixed play.

tactics.name: 5-Out Purposeful Movement / Timing & Spacing
tactics.source_title: FIBA/WABC Level 1 Coaching Manual
steps: A top player passes and cuts.
The cutter continues toward the basket after crossing the free-throw line.
A second player replaces the vacated perimeter space at the correct timing.
Players read teammates and defenders rather than moving mechanically along the three-point line.
tactics.adaptation_note: This is a motion-offense teaching pattern, not a single dead-ball set.

tactics.name: 5-Out Pass & Screen Away
tactics.source_title: FIBA/WABC Level 1 Coaching Manual
steps: Pass to the wing.
The passer sets a down-screen/screen-away for another perimeter player or low-post player.
The screened player uses the screen and relocates.
A pass-and-cut action can flow into a baseline screen for the next player.
tactics.adaptation_note: Use the source diagrams to define one fixed five-player variant for animation.

tactics.name: 5-Out Ball Reversal
tactics.theme: Reverse the ball to move defenders
tactics.source_title: FIBA/WABC Level 1 Coaching Manual
steps: Pass the ball across the perimeter through a reversal sequence.
Players relocate as the ball moves from side to side.
Defenders must shift to new positions.
When a defender is late or poorly positioned, the offense may attack the opening with a drive.
tactics.adaptation_note: This play is best taught as a decision-making pattern: reverse -> observe defense -> attack advantage.

tactics.name: UCLA Cut
tactics.source_title: FIBA/WABC Level 3 Coaching Manual
steps: A perimeter player passes.
The passer cuts toward the basket.
A high-post player sets the screen that supports the cut.
If the cut does not produce a pass, the cutter can clear/relocate and the offense continues.
tactics.adaptation_note: FIBA defines UCLA Cut as a simple pass-and-cut motion using a high-post screen. Specific five-player variants should be stored separately.

tactics.name: Flex
tactics.source_title: FIBA/WABC Level 3 Coaching Manual
steps: A player cuts along the baseline using a back-screen.
The ball is reversed.
A screen-the-screener action follows.
The same structure continues on the other side of the floor.

player_roles.1: Ball reversal and screener in source sequence

tactics.adaptation_note: The source describes Flex as a continuity offense; treat the animation as one cycle rather than a single-shot play.
